name: Total Effluent Contaminant Load Structural Composition
description: Total effluent dissolved solids load is structurally composed from suspended solids, dissolved organic carbon, and conductivity contributions — three independent uncertainty sources. Structural UPR: total CZ is Minkowski sum.
